verses.en: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpeh, saying, There shall not any of us give his daughter unto Benjamin to wife.
verses.pt: E os homens de Israel haviam jurado em Mispá, dizendo: Nenhum de nós dará sua filha aos de Benjamim por mulher.
verses.en_web: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpah, saying, “None of us will give his daughter to Benjamin as a wife.”
verses.en_bbe: Now the men of Israel had taken an oath in Mizpah, saying, Not one of us will give his daughter as a wife to Benjamin.

verses.en: And the people came to the house of God, and abode there till even before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept sore;
verses.pt: E veio o povo à casa de Deus, e estiveram ali até à tarde diante de Deus; e levantando sua voz fizeram grande pranto, e disseram:
verses.en_web: The people came to Bethel, and sat there until evening before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept severely.
verses.en_bbe: And the people came to Beth-el, waiting there till evening before God, and gave themselves up to bitter weeping.

verses.en: And said, O LORD God of Israel, why is this come to pass in Israel, that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel?
verses.pt: Ó SENHOR Deus de Israel, por que sucedeu isto em Israel, que falte hoje de Israel uma tribo?
verses.en_web: They said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, why has this happened in Israel, that there should be one tribe lacking in Israel today?”
verses.en_bbe: And they said, O Lord, the God of Israel, why has this fate come on Israel, that today one tribe has been cut off from Israel?

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people rose early, and built there an altar, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.
verses.pt: E ao dia seguinte o povo se levantou de manhã, e edificaram ali altar, e ofereceram holocaustos e pacíficos.
verses.en_web: On the next day, the people rose early, and built an altar there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.
verses.en_bbe: Then on the day after, the people got up early and made an altar there, offering burned offerings and peace-offerings.

verses.en: And the children of Israel said, Who is there among all the tribes of Israel that came not up with the congregation unto the LORD? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to the LORD to Mizpeh, saying, He shall surely be put to death.
verses.pt: E disseram os filhos de Israel: Quem de todas as tribos de Israel não subiu à reunião próximo do SENHOR? Porque se havia feito grande juramento contra o que não subisse ao SENHOR em Mispá, dizendo: Sofrerá morte.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel said, “Who is there among all the tribes of Israel who didn’t come up in the assembly to Yahweh?” For they had made a great oath concerning him who didn’t come up to Yahweh to Mizpah, saying, “He shall surely be put to death.”
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Israel said, Who is there among all the tribes of Israel, who did not come up to the Lord at the meeting of all Israel? For they had taken a great oath that whoever did not come up to Mizpah to the Lord was to be put to death.

verses.en: And the children of Israel repented them for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Israel se arrependeram por causa de Benjamim seu irmão, e disseram: Uma tribo é hoje cortada de Israel.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel grieved for Benjamin their brother, and said, “There is one tribe cut off from Israel today.
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Israel were moved with pity for Benjamin their brother, saying, Today one tribe has been cut off from Israel.

verses.en: How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing we have sworn by the LORD that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?
verses.pt: Que faremos em quanto a mulheres para os que restaram? Nós juramos pelo SENHOR que não lhes temos de dar nossas filhas por mulheres.
verses.en_web: How shall we provide wives for those who remain, since we have sworn by Yahweh that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?”
verses.en_bbe: What are we to do about wives for those who are still living? For we have taken an oath by the Lord that we will not give them our daughters for wives.

verses.en: And they said, What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpeh to the LORD? And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabesh-gilead to the assembly.
verses.pt: E disseram: Há alguém das tribos de Israel que não tenha subido ao SENHOR em Mispá? E acharam que ninguém de Jabes-Gileade havia vindo ao acampamento à reunião:
verses.en_web: They said, “What one is there of the tribes of Israel who didn’t come up to Yahweh to Mizpah?” Behold, no one came from Jabesh Gilead to the camp to the assembly.
verses.en_bbe: And they said, Which one of the tribes of Israel did not come up to Mizpah to the Lord? And it was seen that no one had come from Jabesh-gilead to the meeting.

verses.en: For the people were numbered, and, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead there.
verses.pt: Porque o povo foi contado, e não havia ali homem dos moradores de Jabes-Gileade.
verses.en_web: For when the people were counted, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead there.
verses.en_bbe: For when the people were numbered, not one man of the people of Jabesh-gilead was present.

verses.en: And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the valiantest, and commanded them, saying, Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the children.
verses.pt: Então a congregação enviou ali doze mil homens dos mais valentes, e mandaram-lhes, dizendo: Ide e ponde à espada aos moradores de Jabes-Gileade, e as mulheres e meninos.
verses.en_web: The congregation sent twelve thousand of the most valiant men there, and commanded them, saying, “Go and strike the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the little ones.
verses.en_bbe: So they (the meeting) sent twelve thousand of the best fighting-men, and gave them orders, saying, Go and put the people of Jabesh-gilead to the sword without mercy, with their women and their little ones.

verses.en: And this is the thing that ye shall do, Ye shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman that hath lain by man.
verses.pt: Mas fareis desta maneira: matareis a todo homem e a toda mulher que tiver se deitado com homem.
verses.en_web: This is the thing that you shall do: you shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman who has lain with a man.”
verses.en_bbe: And this is what you are to do: every male, and every woman who has had sex relations with a man, you are to put to the curse, but you are to keep safe the virgins. And they did so.

verses.en: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young virgins, that had known no man by lying with any male: and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.
verses.pt: E acharam dos moradores de Jabes-Gileade quatrocentas virgens que não tinham se deitado com homem, e trouxeram-nas ao acampamento em Siló, que está na terra de Canaã.
verses.en_web: They found among the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead four hundred young virgins, who had not known man by lying with him; and they brought them to the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.
verses.en_bbe: Now there were among the people of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young virgins who had never had sex relations with a man; these they took to their tents in Shiloh in the land of Canaan.

verses.en: And the whole congregation sent some to speak to the children of Benjamin that were in the rock Rimmon, and to call peaceably unto them.
verses.pt: Toda a congregação enviou logo a falar aos filhos de Benjamim que estavam na penha de Rimom, e chamaram-nos em paz.
verses.en_web: The whole congregation sent and spoke to the children of Benjamin who were in the rock of Rimmon, and proclaimed peace to them.
verses.en_bbe: And all the meeting sent to the men of Benjamin who were in the rock of Rimmon, offering them peace.

verses.en: And Benjamin came again at that time; and they gave them wives which they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh-gilead: and yet so they sufficed them not.
verses.pt: E voltaram então os de Benjamim; e deram-lhes por mulheres as que haviam escravo vivas das mulheres de Jabes-Gileade: mas não lhes bastaram estas.
verses.en_web: Benjamin returned at that time; and they gave them the women whom they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh Gilead. There still weren’t enough for them.
verses.en_bbe: Then Benjamin came back; and they gave them the women whom they had kept from death among the women of Jabesh-gilead: but still there were not enough for them.

verses.en: And the people repented them for Benjamin, because that the LORD had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.
verses.pt: E o povo teve dor por causa de Benjamim, de que o SENHOR houvesse feito brecha nas tribos de Israel.
verses.en_web: The people grieved for Benjamin, because Yahweh had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And the people were moved with pity for Benjamin, because the Lord had let his wrath loose on the tribes of Israel.

verses.en: Then the elders of the congregation said, How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?
verses.pt: Então os anciãos da congregação disseram: Que faremos acerca de mulheres para os que restaram? Porque as mulheres tinham sido exterminadas de Benjamim.
verses.en_web: Then the elders of the congregation said, “How shall we provide wives for those who remain, since the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?”
verses.en_bbe: Then the responsible men of the meeting said, What are we to do about wives for the rest of them, seeing that the women of Benjamin are dead?

verses.en: And they said, There must be an inheritance for them that be escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe be not destroyed out of Israel.
verses.pt: E disseram: A herança dos que escaparam será o que era de Benjamim, para que não seja uma tribo extinta de Israel.
verses.en_web: They said, “There must be an inheritance for those who are escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe not be blotted out from Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And they said, How is the rest of Benjamin to be given offspring so that one tribe of Israel may not be put out of existence,

verses.en: Howbeit we may not give them wives of our daughters: for the children of Israel have sworn, saying, Cursed be he that giveth a wife to Benjamin.
verses.pt: Nós porém, não lhes podemos dar mulheres de nossas filhas, porque os filhos de Israel juraram, dizendo: Maldito o que der mulher a Benjamim.
verses.en_web: However we may not give them wives of our daughters, for the children of Israel had sworn, saying, ‘Cursed is he who gives a wife to Benjamin.’”
verses.en_bbe: Seeing that we may not give them our daughters as wives? For the children of Israel had taken an oath, saying, Cursed is he who gives a wife to Benjamin.

verses.en: Then they said, Behold, there is a feast of the LORD in Shiloh yearly in a place which is on the north side of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.
verses.pt: Agora bem, disseram, eis que cada ano há solenidade do SENHOR em Siló, que está ao norte de Betel, e ao lado oriental do caminho que sobe de Betel a Siquém, e ao sul de Lebona.
verses.en_web: They said, “Behold, there is a feast of Yahweh from year to year in Shiloh, which is on the north of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.”
verses.en_bbe: And they said, See, every year there is a feast of the Lord in Shiloh, which is to the north of Beth-el, on the east side of the highway which goes up from Beth-el to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.

verses.en: Therefore they commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in wait in the vineyards;
verses.pt: E mandaram aos filhos de Benjamim, dizendo: Ide, e ponde emboscadas nas vinhas:
verses.en_web: They commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, “Go and lie in wait in the vineyards,
verses.en_bbe: And they said to the men of Benjamin, Go into the vine-gardens, waiting there secretly,

verses.en: And see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances, then come ye out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.
verses.pt: E estai atentos: e quando virdes sair as filhas de Siló a dançar em cirandas, vós saireis das vinhas, e arrebatareis cada um mulher para si das filhas de Siló, e vos ireis à terra de Benjamim:
verses.en_web: and see, and behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in the dances, then come out of the vineyards, and each man catch his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.
verses.en_bbe: And watching; and if the daughters of Shiloh come out to take part in the dances, then come from the vine-gardens and take a wife for every one of you from among the daughters of Shiloh, and go back to the land of Benjamin.

verses.en: And it shall be, when their fathers or their brethren come unto us to complain, that we will say unto them, Be favourable unto them for our sakes: because we reserved not to each man his wife in the war: for ye did not give unto them at this time, that ye should be guilty.
verses.pt: E quando vierem os pais delas ou seus irmãos a nos exigirem, nós lhes diremos: Tende piedade de nós em lugar deles: pois que nós na guerra não tomamos mulheres para todos: que vós não as destes a eles, para que agora sejais culpáveis.
verses.en_web: It shall be, when their fathers or their brothers come to complain to us, that we will say to them, ‘Grant them graciously to us, because we didn’t take for each man his wife in battle, neither did you give them to them, otherwise you would now be guilty.’”
verses.en_bbe: And when their fathers or their brothers come and make trouble, you are to say to them, Give them to us as an act of grace; for we did not take them as wives for ourselves in war; and if you yourselves had given them to us you would have been responsible for the broken oath.

verses.en: And the children of Benjamin did so, and took them wives, according to their number, of them that danced, whom they caught: and they went and returned unto their inheritance, and repaired the cities, and dwelt in them.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Benjamim o fizeram assim; pois tomaram mulheres conforme seu número, tomando das que dançavam; e indo logo, voltaram-se à sua herança, e reedificaram as cidades, e habitaram nelas.
verses.en_web: The children of Benjamin did so, and took wives for themselves, according to their number, of those who danced, whom they carried off. They went and returned to their inheritance, built the cities, and lived in them.
verses.en_bbe: So the men of Benjamin did this, and got wives for themselves for every one of their number, taking them away by force from the dance; then they went back to their heritage, building up their towns and living in them.

verses.en: And the children of Israel departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.
verses.pt: Então os filhos de Israel se foram também dali, cada um à sua tribo e à sua família, saindo dali cada um à sua propriedade.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel departed from there at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they each went out from there to his own inheritance.
verses.en_bbe: Then the children of Israel went away from there, every man to his tribe and his family, every man went back to his heritage.

verses.en: In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did that which was right in his own eyes.
verses.pt: Nestes dias não havia rei em Israel; cada um fazia o que era correto diante de seus olhos.
verses.en_web: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.
verses.en_bbe: In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did what seemed right to him.
